symptom: Under true-right-false-down an `if` without `else` whose THEN carries on was drawn the default way round: the TRUE activity in a lane below the split (530, 300), the empty FALSE straight to the merge on the line. `create` and `layout flows` both produced it, and layout flows swapped explicit @anchor(true: right) back.
cause: The style only applied to ifHasElse(s); an IF without ELSE always took the default's TRUE-below path, whatever the style.
fix: Under IfElseColumn an IF without ELSE whose THEN carries on is laid out as one with an empty ELSE (HasElse on a copy, in both the builder and the measurer): TRUE on the line, FALSE from the split's bottom into the merge's bottom. The model is the same — an empty ELSE is the false flow into the merge — so describe still prints no `else`. A guard (THEN returns) is left to the guard setting.
insight: The empty-ELSE path already existed and was right; the defect was only which IFs reached it. Applying the copy in the measurer too keeps bounds and positions from disagreeing, which is what the overlap assertions catch.
test: flowlayout_ifelse_column_test.go TestIfElseColumn_IfWithoutElseKeepsTrueOnTheCentreLine (controls: default style keeps TRUE below; a guard keeps TRUE below) failed before the fix at exactly the issue's (530, 300); flowlayout_describe_test.go styled flow gained the shape and describes with no positions. Live 11.17.0: issue repro gives TRUE at (530, 200), false flow bottom->bottom, describe prints the plain `if`, second exec and layout flows --dry-run unchanged, mx check 0 errors.
